props.animation_script:
// ============================================================================

// Stop - Sequencer (Pipeline Version + PSEUDO step forward / step back)

// - Pseudo handles movement only (visual clone, no real token movement)

// - Sequencer handles ALL VFX + SFX

// - CHANGE: Caster VFX is centered on the PSEUDO clone position (not the real token)

// ============================================================================

(async () => {

const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][Stop]";

try {

if (!game.modules.get("sequencer")?.active) {

ui.notifications.error("Sequencer module is not active.");

return;

}

// Minimal ONI.emit helper

globalThis.ONI = globalThis.ONI ?? {};

if (!ONI.emit) {

ONI.emit = function (eventName, payload = {}, options = {}) {

const { local = true, world = false } = options;

if (local) Hooks.callAll(eventName, payload);

if (world) game.socket.emit("world", { action: eventName, payload });

};

}

// -----------------------------

// TUNING KNOBS

// -----------------------------

const MOVE_DURATION = 350; // ms (caster step forward/back)

const STEP_SQUARES = 0.35; // how far to step (in grid squares)

const POST_CAST_WAIT = 2000; // ms

const EST_CAST_VFX_MS = 900;

const EST_TARGET_VFX_MS = 1800;

const EXTRA_BUFFER_MS = 250;

const HOLD_FORWARD_MS =

EST_CAST_VFX_MS + POST_CAST_WAIT + EST_TARGET_VFX_MS + EXTRA_BUFFER_MS;

// -----------------------------

// Assets

// -----------------------------

const FX_CASTER =

"modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/Generic/Cast/CastShapeSquare01_01_Regular_Blue_600x600.webm";

const FX_TARGET =

"modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/Generic/Energy/IcosahedronRoll_01_Regular_Blue_600x600.webm";

const SFX_BEGIN =

"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Beginspell.mp3";

const SFX_POISON =

"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Condition_Poison.ogg";

// -----------------------------

// Payload resolve

// -----------------------------

const payload = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? {};

const isUuid = (v) => typeof v === "string" && v.includes(".");

async function resolveToken(ref) {

if (!ref) return null;

if (ref?.document && ref?.object) return ref;

if (ref?.id && canvas.tokens?.get(ref.id)) return canvas.tokens.get(ref.id);

if (isUuid(ref)) {

const doc = await fromUuid(ref);

if (!doc) return null;

if (doc.object) return doc.object;

if (doc.document?.object) return doc.document.object;

return null;

}

if (typeof ref === "string") return canvas.tokens.get(ref) ?? null;

return null;

}

function pickTargetsFromPayload(p) {

if (Array.isArray(p.targetTokenIds) && p.targetTokenIds.length) return p.targetTokenIds;

if (Array.isArray(p.targets) && p.targets.length) {

const out = [];

for (const t of p.targets) {

if (typeof t === "string") out.push(t);

else if (t?.tokenId) out.push(t.tokenId);

else if (t?.tokenUuid) out.push(t.tokenUuid);

}

return out.filter(Boolean);

}

if (Array.isArray(p.rows)) {

const out = [];

for (const r of p.rows) {

if (r?.targetTokenId) out.push(r.targetTokenId);

if (r?.targetTokenUuid) out.push(r.targetTokenUuid);

}

if (out.length) return out;

}

return [];

}

const sourceRef =

payload.sourceTokenUuid ??

payload.sourceTokenId ??

payload.casterTokenUuid ??

payload.casterTokenId ??

payload.attackerTokenUuid ??

payload.attackerTokenId ??

null;

const targetRefs = pickTargetsFromPayload(payload);

const fallbackSource = canvas.tokens.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

const fallbackTargets = Array.from(game.user.targets ?? []);

const sourceToken = (await resolveToken(sourceRef)) ?? fallbackSource;

const targets = [];

for (const r of targetRefs) {

const tok = await resolveToken(r);

if (tok) targets.push(tok);

}

if (!targets.length && fallbackTargets.length) targets.push(...fallbackTargets);

if (!sourceToken) {

ui.notifications.warn("Stop: No caster token (payload missing and nothing selected).");

return;

}

if (!targets.length) {

ui.notifications.warn("Stop: No targets (payload missing and nothing targeted).");

return;

}

const targetToken = targets[0];

// -----------------------------

// Disposition -> step direction

// -----------------------------

const casterDisposition =

sourceToken?.actor?.document?.disposition ?? sourceToken?.document?.disposition ?? 0;

const casterMoveRight = casterDisposition === -1;

const offsetPx = (canvas.grid.size ?? 100) * STEP_SQUARES;

const dx = casterMoveRight ? +offsetPx : -offsetPx;

// -----------------------------

// Emit START

// -----------------------------

ONI.emit(

"oni:animationStart",

{

type: "stop",

sourceTokenId: sourceToken.id,

targetTokenIds: [targetToken.id],

sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,

timestamp: Date.now(),

},

{ local: true, world: false }

);

// -----------------------------

// PSEUDO availability

// -----------------------------

const hasPseudo = !!game.ONI?.pseudo?.play;

// Used to tighten animationEnd timing

const pseudoDoneKey = `oni.stop.pseudoDone.${Date.now()}.${foundry.utils.randomID()}`;

globalThis[pseudoDoneKey] = false;

// NEW: live position key for the pseudo clone center (canvas coords)

const pseudoPosKey = `oni.stop.pseudoPos.${Date.now()}.${foundry.utils.randomID()}`;

globalThis[pseudoPosKey] = null;

const waitForPseudoDone = async (timeoutMs = 12000) => {

const start = performance.now();

while (!globalThis[pseudoDoneKey]) {

if (performance.now() - start > timeoutMs) break;

await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 25));

}

};

// Helper to read the pseudo clone position (fallback to token center)

const getCasterVfxLocation = () => {

const p = globalThis[pseudoPosKey];

if (p && Number.isFinite(p.x) && Number.isFinite(p.y)) return { x: p.x, y: p.y };

return { x: sourceToken.center.x, y: sourceToken.center.y };

};

// -----------------------------

// 1) Pseudo session: move out -> HOLD -> move back

// -----------------------------

if (hasPseudo) {

const pseudoScriptSource = `

const { casterToken, params } = ctx;

if (!casterToken) throw new Error("StopPseudo: casterToken missing");

const dx = Number(params.dx ?? 0);

const dur = Number(params.dur ?? 300);

const hold = Number(params.hold ?? 0);

const doneKey = String(params.doneKey ?? "");

const posKey = String(params.posKey ?? "");

function easeInOutCubic(t) {

return t < 0.5 ? 4*t*t*t : 1 - Math.pow(-2*t + 2, 3)/2;

}

function writePos(obj) {

if (!posKey) return;

globalThis[posKey] = { x: obj.x, y: obj.y };

}

function animate(obj, fromX, fromY, toX, toY, durMs) {

return new Promise(resolve => {

const startTime = performance.now();

const ticker = canvas.app.ticker;

const update = () => {

const raw = (performance.now() - startTime) / durMs;

const t = Math.min(Math.max(raw, 0), 1);

const e = easeInOutCubic(t);

obj.x = fromX + (toX - fromX) * e;

obj.y = fromY + (toY - fromY) * e;

writePos(obj);

if (t >= 1) { ticker.remove(update); resolve(); }

};

ticker.add(update);

});

}

async function createClone(token) {

const baseObj = token.mesh ?? token.icon;

const texture = baseObj?.texture ?? await loadTexture(token.document.texture.src);

const sprite = new PIXI.Sprite(texture);

sprite.anchor.set(0.5);

sprite.x = token.center.x;

sprite.y = token.center.y;

if (baseObj) { sprite.width = baseObj.width; sprite.height = baseObj.height; }

sprite.zIndex = 5000;

canvas.stage.sortableChildren = true;

canvas.stage.addChild(sprite);

canvas.stage.sortChildren();

writePos(sprite); // initial position publish

return sprite;

}

const baseMesh = casterToken.mesh ?? casterToken.icon;

const originalTokenVisible = casterToken.visible;

const originalMeshVisible = baseMesh?.visible ?? true;

let sprite;

try {

sprite = await createClone(casterToken);

// Hide real token visuals (local only) for the WHOLE session

if (baseMesh) baseMesh.visible = false;

casterToken.visible = false;

const startX = sprite.x;

const startY = sprite.y;

const outX = startX + dx;

const outY = startY;

// Move out

await animate(sprite, startX, startY, outX, outY, dur);

// Hold while Sequencer VFX/SFX plays

if (hold > 0) {

// keep publishing position during hold (in case other code reads it later)

writePos(sprite);

await wait(hold);

writePos(sprite);

}

// Move back

await animate(sprite, outX, outY, startX, startY, dur);

} finally {

if (sprite) {

writePos(sprite); // final publish

canvas.stage.removeChild(sprite);

sprite.destroy(); // IMPORTANT: no "true"

}

if (baseMesh) baseMesh.visible = originalMeshVisible;

casterToken.visible = originalTokenVisible;

// Signal completion back to macro (local flag)

if (doneKey) globalThis[doneKey] = true;

}

`;

game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: "stop.pseudoSession",

scriptSource: pseudoScriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken.document.uuid,

targetTokenUuids: [targetToken.document.uuid],

params: {

dx,

dur: MOVE_DURATION,

hold: HOLD_FORWARD_MS,

doneKey: pseudoDoneKey,

posKey: pseudoPosKey, // <-- NEW

},

meta: { source: "Stop" },

});

} else {

// Fallback: real token movement (only if pseudo missing)

const original = { x: sourceToken.document.x, y: sourceToken.document.y };

await sourceToken.document.update({ x: original.x + dx, y: original.y });

// approximate “pos” for caster VFX (token center)

globalThis[pseudoPosKey] = { x: sourceToken.center.x, y: sourceToken.center.y };

globalThis[pseudoDoneKey] = true;

}

// -----------------------------

// 2) Sequencer timeline (VFX + SFX only)

// Start after the step-out finishes (+ tiny buffer)

// -----------------------------

await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, MOVE_DURATION + 30));

// IMPORTANT: cast VFX centered on the pseudo clone position

const casterVfxLoc = getCasterVfxLocation();

const casterSeq = new Sequence()

.sound()

.file(SFX_BEGIN)

.volume(0.9)

.effect()

.file(FX_CASTER)

.atLocation(casterVfxLoc) // <-- CHANGED: not sourceToken

.scaleToObject(1.5);

await casterSeq.play();

// Wait 2000ms (your requirement)

await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, POST_CAST_WAIT));

// Target icosahedron + poison sound, then WAIT UNTIL FINISHED

const targetSeq = new Sequence();

targetSeq.sound().file(SFX_POISON).volume(0.9);

targetSeq

.effect()

.file(FX_TARGET)

.atLocation(targetToken)

.scaleToObject(1.5)

.waitUntilFinished();

await targetSeq.play();

// -----------------------------

// Tighter animationEnd:

// wait for pseudo move-back to actually finish

// -----------------------------

if (hasPseudo) {

await waitForPseudoDone(12000);

} else {

// Fallback: return real token

const original = { x: sourceToken.document.x - dx, y: sourceToken.document.y };

await sourceToken.document.update({ x: original.x, y: original.y });

}

// Cleanup

try { delete globalThis[pseudoDoneKey]; } catch (_) {}

try { delete globalThis[pseudoPosKey]; } catch (_) {}

// -----------------------------

// Emit END (tight)

// -----------------------------

ONI.emit(

"oni:animationEnd",

{

type: "stop",

sourceTokenId: sourceToken.id,

targetTokenIds: [targetToken.id],

sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,

timestamp: Date.now(),

},

{ local: true, world: false }

);

console.log(TAG, "END");

} catch (err) {

console.error(`${TAG} Animation crashed:`, err);

try {

globalThis.ONI?.emit?.(

"oni:animationEnd",

{ type: "stop", error: true, timestamp: Date.now() },

{ local: true }

);

} catch (_) {}

}

})();
props.custom_logic_resolution:
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// Stop — Custom Logic: Resolution

// Foundry V12 / Fabula Ultima Companion / Lancer Initiative

//

// Spell effect handled here:

// - If Stop HITS the target: target performs 1 fewer activation

// on their next available turn/activation, minimum 0.

// - If Stop MISSES: do nothing.

// - Player-safe: if this script is ever run by a non-GM client,

// it forwards the actual combatant mutation to GMExecutor.

//

// Behavior:

// - If the hit target still has activations.value > 0 this round,

// reduce activations.value by 1 immediately.

// - If the hit target has activations.value <= 0,

// store a pending Stop flag and consume 1 activation as soon as

// they gain a future activation, usually next round.

//

// Important:

// - Do NOT add @local-ui-only.

// - This script is meant for Custom Logic - Resolution.

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

async function __runStopAuthorityCore__() {

const TAG = "[CL-RES][Stop]";

const MODULE_ID = "fabula-ultima-companion";

const LI = "lancer-initiative";

const FLAG_KEY = "stopPendingActivationLoss";

const GLOBAL_KEY = "__ONI_STOP_ACTIVATION_MANAGER__";

const VERSION = 1;

const CLEANUP_DELAY_MS = 120;

// Allow multiple different Stop casts to stack as multiple pending losses.

// Same action card is still deduped so double-client execution does not double-apply.

const ALLOW_STACKING_FROM_DIFFERENT_ACTIONS = true;

const p =

(typeof __PAYLOAD !== "undefined" && __PAYLOAD)

? __PAYLOAD

: (typeof payload !== "undefined" ? payload : null);

const args =

(typeof __ARGS !== "undefined" && __ARGS)

? __ARGS

: (typeof window !== "undefined" ? window.__ARGS : {});

const rawTargets =

(typeof __TARGETS !== "undefined" && Array.isArray(__TARGETS))

? __TARGETS

: [];

if (!p) {

console.warn(TAG, "Missing payload.");

return { ok: false, reason: "missing-payload" };

}

p.meta = p.meta || {};

const wait = (ms) => new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, ms));

function hasOwn(obj, key) {

return Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(obj ?? {}, key);

}

function collectionValues(collection) {

if (!collection) return [];

if (Array.isArray(collection)) return collection;

if (collection instanceof Map) return Array.from(collection.values());

if (typeof collection.values === "function") return Array.from(collection.values());

if (Array.isArray(collection.contents)) return collection.contents;

if (typeof collection === "object") return Object.values(collection);

return [];

}

function dedupeStrings(list) {

return Array.from(new Set(

(Array.isArray(list) ? list : [])

.filter(Boolean)

.map(v => String(v).trim())

.filter(Boolean)

));

}

function numberish(value, fallback = 0) {

const n = Number(value);

return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : fallback;

}

function readLiNumber(combatant, path, fallback = 0) {

try {

return numberish(combatant?.getFlag?.(LI, path), fallback);

} catch (_) {

return fallback;

}

}

async function setLiNumber(combatant, path, value) {

return combatant?.setFlag?.(LI, path, Math.max(0, Number(value) || 0));

}

function emitTurnBarRefresh(reason = "stop") {

try {

globalThis.__ONI_FABULA_INITIATIVE__?.refresh?.(reason);

} catch (_) {}

try {

game.socket?.emit?.(`module.${MODULE_ID}`, {

scope: "fabula-initiative",

type: "REFRESH",

reason

});

} catch (_) {}

}

function getActionCardId() {

return String(

p?.meta?.actionCardId ??

p?.actionCardId ??

p?.meta?.sourceActionCardId ??

p?.sourceActionCardId ??

p?.meta?.actionId ??

p?.actionId ??

`STOP-NO-CARD-${Date.now()}`

).trim();

}

function getTargetUuids() {

return dedupeStrings([

...rawTargets,

...(

Array.isArray(p?.originalTargetUUIDs) && p.originalTargetUUIDs.length

? p.originalTargetUUIDs

: []

),

...(

Array.isArray(p?.meta?.originalTargetUUIDs) && p.meta.originalTargetUUIDs.length

? p.meta.originalTargetUUIDs

: []

),

...(

Array.isArray(args?.originalTargetUUIDs) && args.originalTargetUUIDs.length

? args.originalTargetUUIDs

: []

),

...(

Array.isArray(args?.targets) && args.targets.length

? args.targets

: []

),

...(

Array.isArray(p?.targets) && p.targets.length

? p.targets

: []

)

]);

}

async function resolveActorAndToken(uuidOrDoc) {

if (!uuidOrDoc) return { actor: null, tokenDoc: null, doc: null };

let doc = uuidOrDoc;

if (typeof uuidOrDoc === "string") {

try {

doc = await fromUuid(uuidOrDoc);

} catch (err) {

console.warn(TAG, "fromUuid failed.", {

uuidOrDoc,

error: String(err?.message ?? err)

});

return { actor: null, tokenDoc: null, doc: null };

}

}

if (!doc) return { actor: null, tokenDoc: null, doc: null };

const documentName = doc.documentName ?? doc.constructor?.name ?? "";

if (documentName === "Token" || documentName === "TokenDocument") {

return {

actor: doc.actor ?? doc.object?.actor ?? null,

tokenDoc: doc.documentName === "Token" ? doc : (doc.document ?? doc),

doc

};

}

if (documentName === "Actor") {

const activeToken =

doc.getActiveTokens?.(true, true)?.[0] ??

doc.getActiveTokens?.()?.[0] ??

null;

return {

actor: doc,

tokenDoc: activeToken?.document ?? null,

doc

};

}

const actor =

doc.actor ??

doc.object?.actor ??

doc.token?.actor ??

doc.parent?.actor ??

doc.document?.actor ??

null;

const tokenDoc =

doc.documentName === "Token"

? doc

: doc.document?.documentName === "Token"

? doc.document

: doc.token?.documentName === "Token"

? doc.token

: doc.token?.document?.documentName === "Token"

? doc.token.document

: null;

return { actor, tokenDoc, doc };

}

function findCombatantForActorOrToken(combat, actor, tokenDoc) {

if (!combat) return null;

const combatants = collectionValues(combat.combatants);

const actorId = actor?.id ?? null;

const actorUuid = actor?.uuid ?? null;

const tokenId = tokenDoc?.id ?? null;

const tokenUuid = tokenDoc?.uuid ?? null;

if (tokenId || tokenUuid) {

const byToken = combatants.find(c => {

const cTokenUuid = c.token?.uuid ?? c.tokenUuid ?? null;

return (

(tokenId && (c.tokenId === tokenId || c.token?.id === tokenId)) ||

(tokenUuid && cTokenUuid === tokenUuid)

);

});

if (byToken) return byToken;

}

if (actorId || actorUuid) {

const byActor = combatants.find(c => {

const cActor =

c.actor ??

(c.actorId ? game.actors?.get?.(c.actorId) : null);

return (

(actorId && (c.actorId === actorId || cActor?.id === actorId)) ||

(actorUuid && cActor?.uuid === actorUuid)

);

});

if (byActor) return byActor;

}

return null;

}

function getCombatForCombatant(combatant) {

if (!combatant) return game.combat ?? null;

const parent = combatant.parent ?? null;

if (parent?.documentName === "Combat" || parent?.constructor?.name === "Combat") {

return parent;

}

for (const combat of collectionValues(game.combats)) {

if (combat?.combatants?.get?.(combatant.id)) return combat;

if (collectionValues(combat?.combatants).some(c => c?.id === combatant.id)) return combat;

}

return game.combat ?? null;

}

function getSnapshotRowForTarget(targetUuid, targetActor, tokenDoc) {

const rows = Array.isArray(p?.meta?.defenseSnapshot?.perTarget)

? p.meta.defenseSnapshot.perTarget

: [];

const targetUuidStr = String(targetUuid ?? "");

const actorUuid = String(targetActor?.uuid ?? "");

const tokenUuid = String(tokenDoc?.uuid ?? "");

return rows.find(row => {

const candidates = [

row?.uuid,

row?.targetUuid,

row?.tokenUuid,

row?.actorUuid,

row?.id

].filter(Boolean).map(String);

return (

candidates.includes(targetUuidStr) ||

(actorUuid && candidates.includes(actorUuid)) ||

(tokenUuid && candidates.includes(tokenUuid))

);

}) ?? null;

}

function readDefenseLikeFromProps(props, preferMagic = true) {

const p2 = props ?? {};

const hard = preferMagic

? ["magic_defense", "current_mdef", "mdef", "m_defense", "magicDefense"]

: ["defense", "current_def", "def"];

for (const key of hard) {

const n = numberish(p2[key], NaN);

if (Number.isFinite(n)) return n;

}

const isBanned = (key) => /(^|_)mod($|_)/i.test(key);

const rePhys = /(^|_)(current_)?(def|guard|armor)($|_)/i;

const reMag = /(^|_)(current_)?(m(def|agic.*def)|magic.*resist|spirit)($|_)/i;

const rx = preferMagic ? reMag : rePhys;

for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(p2)) {

if (isBanned(key)) continue;

const n = numberish(value, NaN);

if (!Number.isFinite(n)) continue;

if (rx.test(key)) return n;

}

return 0;

}

function getDefenseForHitCheck(targetUuid, targetActor, tokenDoc) {

const preferMagic = true; // Stop is a Spell, so compare against Magic Defense.

const row = getSnapshotRowForTarget(targetUuid, targetActor, tokenDoc);

const snapshotDefense = numberish(

row?.mdef ??

row?.magicDefense ??

row?.magic_defense ??

row?.defenseUsed ??

row?.defense,

NaN

);

if (Number.isFinite(snapshotDefense)) return snapshotDefense;

const props = targetActor?.system?.props ?? targetActor?.system ?? {};

return readDefenseLikeFromProps(props, preferMagic);

}

function buildHitCheckContext() {

const accTotal = Number(

p?.accuracy?.total ??

args?.accuracyTotal ??

args?.accTotal ??

NaN

);

const hasAccuracy =

(typeof args?.hasAccuracy === "boolean")

? args.hasAccuracy

: !!p?.accuracy;

const explicitForceMiss = !!(

args?.forceMiss === true ||

args?.advPayload?.forceMiss === true ||

args?.advPayload?.isFumble === true ||

p?.accuracy?.forceMiss === true ||

p?.accuracy?.isFumble === true ||

p?.meta?.forceMiss === true

);

const explicitAutoHit = !!(

!explicitForceMiss &&

(

args?.autoHit === true ||

args?.advPayload?.autoHit === true ||

args?.advPayload?.isCrit === true ||

p?.advPayload?.autoHit === true ||

p?.advPayload?.isCrit === true ||

p?.accuracy?.isCrit === true ||

p?.meta?.autoHit === true

)

);

return {

accTotal,

hasAccuracy,

explicitForceMiss,

explicitAutoHit

};

}

function isHitTarget(targetUuid, targetActor, tokenDoc) {

const hitCtx = buildHitCheckContext();

if (hitCtx.explicitForceMiss) {

return {

hit: false,

reason: "force-miss-or-fumble",

...hitCtx,

defenseUsed: null

};

}

if (!hitCtx.hasAccuracy) {

return {

hit: true,

reason: "no-accuracy-treated-as-hit",

...hitCtx,

defenseUsed: null

};

}

if (hitCtx.explicitAutoHit) {

return {

hit: true,

reason: "auto-hit",

...hitCtx,

defenseUsed: null

};

}

const defenseUsed = getDefenseForHitCheck(targetUuid, targetActor, tokenDoc);

if (!Number.isFinite(hitCtx.accTotal)) {

return {

hit: false,

reason: "missing-accuracy-total",

...hitCtx,

defenseUsed

};

}

return {

hit: hitCtx.accTotal >= defenseUsed,

reason: hitCtx.accTotal >= defenseUsed ? "accuracy-meets-defense" : "accuracy-below-defense",

...hitCtx,

defenseUsed

};

}

function buildStopFlagData({

existing = {},

combat,

combatant,

targetActor,

tokenDoc,

pendingLoss,

actionCardId,

source = "Stop",

active = true,

consumed = false

} = {}) {

const previousActionIds = Array.isArray(existing?.actionCardIds)

? existing.actionCardIds

: [];

const actionCardIds = Array.from(new Set([

...previousActionIds,

actionCardId

].filter(Boolean).map(String)));

return {

active,

consumed,

source,

combatId: combat?.id ?? null,

combatantId: combatant?.id ?? null,

actorUuid: targetActor?.uuid ?? null,

tokenUuid: tokenDoc?.uuid ?? null,

appliedRound: Number(existing?.appliedRound ?? combat?.round ?? 0) || 0,

lastTouchedRound: Number(combat?.round ?? 0) || 0,

pendingLoss: Math.max(0, Number(pendingLoss) || 0),

actionId: p?.meta?.actionId ?? p?.actionId ?? null,

actionCardId: actionCardId || null,

actionCardIds,

appliedAt: Number(existing?.appliedAt ?? Date.now()) || Date.now(),

updatedAt: Date.now(),

appliedByUserId: existing?.appliedByUserId ?? game.userId ?? null,

authorityUserId: game.userId ?? null,

authorityUserIsGM: !!game.user?.isGM

};

}

async function tryConsumePendingStop(combat, combatant, reason = "pending-check") {

if (!combat || !combatant) return { ok: false, reason: "missing-combat-or-combatant" };

const data = combatant.getFlag?.(MODULE_ID, FLAG_KEY);

if (!data?.active) return { ok: true, skipped: true, reason: "no-active-pending-stop" };

if (data.combatId && data.combatId !== combat.id) {

return { ok: true, skipped: true, reason: "different-combat" };

const pendingLoss = Math.max(0, Number(data.pendingLoss ?? 1) || 0);

if (pendingLoss <= 0) {

return { ok: true, cleaned: true, reason: "empty-pending-loss" };

}

const currentValue = readLiNumber(combatant, "activations.value", 0);

if (currentValue <= 0) {

pending: true,

reason: "no-activation-available-yet",

pendingLoss,

currentValue

};

}

const lossNow = Math.min(currentValue, pendingLoss);

const nextValue = Math.max(0, currentValue - lossNow);

const remainingLoss = Math.max(0, pendingLoss - lossNow);

await setLiNumber(combatant, "activations.value", nextValue);

if (remainingLoss > 0) {

const nextFlag = {

...data,

active: true,

consumed: false,

pendingLoss: remainingLoss,

lastTouchedRound: Number(combat.round ?? 0) || 0,

updatedAt: Date.now()

};

await combatant.setFlag(MODULE_ID, FLAG_KEY, nextFlag);

} else {

const nextFlag = {

...data,

active: false,

consumed: true,

pendingLoss: 0,

consumedRound: Number(combat.round ?? 0) || 0,

consumedAt: Date.now(),

updatedAt: Date.now()

};

await combatant.setFlag(MODULE_ID, FLAG_KEY, nextFlag);

console.log(TAG, "Consumed pending Stop activation loss.", {

reason,

target: combatant.name,

combatId: combat.id,

round: combat.round,

value: `${currentValue} -> ${nextValue}`,

lossNow,

remainingLoss

});

ok: true,

consumed: true,

lossNow,

remainingLoss,

valueBefore: currentValue,

valueAfter: nextValue

};

async function applyStopToCombatant(combat, combatant, targetActor, tokenDoc) {

return { ok: false, reason: "missing-combat-or-combatant" };

}

const existing = combatant.getFlag?.(MODULE_ID, FLAG_KEY) ?? {};

const existingActionIds = Array.isArray(existing?.actionCardIds)

? existing.actionCardIds.map(String)

: [];

if (actionCardId && existingActionIds.includes(String(actionCardId))) {

console.log(TAG, "Stop already applied for this action card. Skipping duplicate.", {

target: combatant.name,

actionCardId

});

return {

ok: true,

skipped: true,

reason: "duplicate-action-card",

combatantId: combatant.id

};

}

if (

existing?.active &&

!ALLOW_STACKING_FROM_DIFFERENT_ACTIONS

) {

console.log(TAG, "Stop already pending on this target. Stacking disabled; skipping.", {

target: combatant.name,

existing

});

return {

ok: true,

skipped: true,

reason: "already-pending-stacking-disabled",

combatantId: combatant.id

};

}

const oldValue = readLiNumber(combatant, "activations.value", 0);

// If the target still has an activation available, remove it immediately.

if (oldValue > 0) {

const nextValue = Math.max(0, oldValue - 1);

await setLiNumber(combatant, "activations.value", nextValue);

const flagData = buildStopFlagData({

existing,

combat,

combatant,

targetActor,

tokenDoc,

pendingLoss: 0,

actionCardId,

active: false,

consumed: true

});

flagData.consumedRound = Number(combat.round ?? 0) || 0;

flagData.consumedAt = Date.now();

flagData.immediate = true;

await combatant.setFlag(MODULE_ID, FLAG_KEY, flagData);

emitTurnBarRefresh("stop-immediate");

console.log(TAG, "Stop HIT: removed 1 available activation immediately.", {

target: combatant.name,

round: combat.round,

value: `${oldValue} -> ${nextValue}`

});

return {

ok: true,

applied: true,

mode: "immediate",

combatantId: combatant.id,

valueBefore: oldValue,

valueAfter: nextValue

};

}

// Otherwise, store a pending loss for the next time they gain an activation.

const oldPending = existing?.active

? Math.max(0, Number(existing.pendingLoss ?? 1) || 1)

: 0;

const nextPending = oldPending + 1;

const flagData = buildStopFlagData({

existing,

combat,

combatant,

targetActor,

tokenDoc,

pendingLoss: nextPending,

actionCardId,

active: true,

consumed: false

});

await combatant.setFlag(MODULE_ID, FLAG_KEY, flagData);

console.log(TAG, "Stop HIT: target has no available activation now, stored pending activation loss.", {

target: combatant.name,

round: combat.round,

oldPending,

nextPending

});

return {

ok: true,

applied: true,

mode: "pending",

combatantId: combatant.id,

pendingLoss: nextPending

};

}

async function applyAllPendingStops(combat, reason = "bulk-pending-check") {

if (!combat) return { ok: false, reason: "missing-combat" };

let checked = 0;

let consumed = 0;

for (const combatant of collectionValues(combat.combatants)) {

const data = combatant.getFlag?.(MODULE_ID, FLAG_KEY);

if (!data?.active) continue;

checked++;

const result = await tryConsumePendingStop(combat, combatant, reason);

if (result?.consumed) consumed++;

}

return { ok: true, checked, consumed };

}

async function cleanupOldStopLedgers(combat, reason = "cleanup") {

if (!combat) return { ok: false, reason: "missing-combat" };

let cleaned = 0;

const currentRound = Number(combat.round ?? 0) || 0;

for (const combatant of collectionValues(combat.combatants)) {

const data = combatant.getFlag?.(MODULE_ID, FLAG_KEY);

if (!data) continue;

if (data.active) continue;

const touchedRound = Number(data.lastTouchedRound ?? data.consumedRound ?? data.appliedRound ?? 0) || 0;

// Keep same-round ledger to dedupe duplicate clients.

// Clean it once the combat moves beyond that round.

if (currentRound > touchedRound) {

await combatant.unsetFlag(MODULE_ID, FLAG_KEY);

cleaned++;

}

}

if (cleaned > 0) {

console.log(TAG, "Cleaned old Stop ledgers.", {

reason,

combatId: combat.id,

round: currentRound,

cleaned

});

}

return { ok: true, cleaned };

}

function installStopHooksOnce() {

if (old?.installed && old.version === VERSION) return old;

if (old?.hookIds?.length) {

}

await combatant.unsetFlag(MODULE_ID, FLAG_KEY);

}

}

});

const hCombatRound = Hooks.on("combatRound", async (combat) => {

const hFabulaRoundChanged = Hooks.on("oni.fabulaInitiative.roundChanged", async (event) => {

game.combats?.get?.(event?.combatId) ??

game.combat ??

null;

await cleanupOldStopLedgers(combat, "fabula-roundChanged");

const hUpdateCombatant = Hooks.on("updateCombatant", async (combatant, changed) => {

if (!combatant) return;

const data = combatant.getFlag?.(MODULE_ID, FLAG_KEY);

if (!data?.active) return;

// When activations.value changes from a later reset/grant, try to consume pending Stop.

!!changedFlags ||

JSON.stringify(changed ?? {}).includes("activations");

if (!mayHaveActivationChange) return;

await wait(CLEANUP_DELAY_MS);

const hDeleteCombat = Hooks.on("deleteCombat", async (combat) => {

if (!combat) return;

for (const combatant of collectionValues(combat.combatants)) {

if (!data) continue;

await combatant.unsetFlag(MODULE_ID, FLAG_KEY);

} catch (_) {}

}

});

state.hookIds.push(

["updateCombat", hUpdateCombat],

["combatRound", hCombatRound],

["oni.fabulaInitiative.roundChanged", hFabulaRoundChanged],

["updateCombatant", hUpdateCombatant],

["deleteCombat", hDeleteCombat]

);

globalThis[GLOBAL_KEY] = state;

console.log(TAG, "Installed Stop activation hooks.");

return state;

}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// Main execution

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

installStopHooksOnce();

const combat = game.combat ?? null;

if (!combat || !combat.started) {
